purpose: Document first-party discovery, current public GIS service review, bounded anonymous access, safe-field handling, and uncertainty.
assessment: The City of Escondido exposes an official ArcGIS parcel FeatureServer/MapServer. Its public metadata identifies polygon geometry, APN semantics, CRS 102646, and GeoJSON support. Anonymous metadata, safe-field, exact-point, bounded-envelope, and three-object-ID geometry requests were executed. The exact WUP point and nearby envelope returned no features; the object-ID request returned three polygons, retained with only one canonical native identity per feature.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is supported by the City of Escondido's official local GIS parcel layer and public parcel lookup context. This is local public GIS/cadastre evidence, not a claim that every parcel is current or complete.

queries.query: site:escondido.gov GIS parcel map Escondido official parcel data API
queries.outcome: Found official City Planning/Maps pages and the City GIS parcel FeatureServer/MapServer.
No distinct Spanish-language official service was found; the English City GIS service was used as the official local source.

attempts.result: Official planning page loaded; public parcel/property-information context confirmed.
Official layer metadata loaded; polygon geometry, CRS 102646, public Query, GeoJSON support, APN/OBJECTID fields, and source description recorded.
Official MapServer layer metadata independently confirmed the parcel layer and APN semantics.

attempts.parameters: f=geojson; geometry point -117.195352456462,33.1691791253299; inSR=4326; intersects; outFields=OBJECTID,APN,ASSETSTATUS; outSR=4326
attempts.result: Zero features at the exact WUP point. This is an exact-point miss only; point was preserved and not shifted.

attempts.parameters: f=geojson; envelope -117.205,33.16,-117.185,33.18; inSR=4326; intersects; outFields=OBJECTID,APN,ASSETSTATUS; outSR=4326; resultRecordCount=3
attempts.result: Zero features in the bounded envelope request; not treated as evidence of citywide absence.
Three full polygon features returned; retained as safe samples after reducing properties to canonical id values.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Zero exact-point features; this does not establish citywide absence and no coordinate shift was made.

remainingUncertainty: The attempt did not independently validate complete current citywide coverage, parcel currency, or an exact-point parcel at the supplied WUP coordinate. The service contains proposed, retired, and stacked parcels; APN semantics vary for proposed parcels.
runtimeAssessment: held; serial reviewer must independently qualify any adapter
